description: Agent Claims: submit a claim payment record with the settlement or adjudication it pays: the payment with its reference, the claim number it cites, the settlement or adjudication it says it pays, the currency, the gross before anything is withheld, the deductible withheld, the depreciation withheld, the amount paid, each payee and the day paid; the terms with their kind (settlement or adjudication), reference, claim number, currency, the figure agreed or adjudicated as payable, each payee they name, the deductible they cite and the depreciation they allow to be withheld. The signed report gives the payment and the terms, the amount paid against the agreed or adjudicated figure, each payee on the payment paired with the payees the terms name both ways, and the deductible and depreciation withheld against the terms, and counts them, and names a divergent payment: an amount unlike the agreed or adjudicated figure or in another currency, a payee added or left off unlike the settlement, and a deductible or depreciation withheld unlike the terms the payment cites; then a paid amount unlike its gross less what it withholds and another settlement or claim reference, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No figure on the terms, no amount paid, no payees on either record, or no deductible or depreciation on either record leaves those points unverified. Amounts compare to the cent in one currency, a withholding the terms do not cite reads as above none, and payees read as parties without case, punctuation or a legal suffix. This reads the payment record against the terms it carries out. Verdict claims_payment_divergent, claims_payment_partial, claims_payment_unverified or claims_payment_consistent. POST /api/claims-payment-check. Reads the claim records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between claim documents only: it never files or submits a claim, never negotiates or pays one and never decides coverage, which stays with the insurer, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Claims reads claim records across the claim lifecycle for consistency between the claim documents and the policy they claim under: a first notice of loss, a sworn proof of loss, an adjuster’s report, a repair or replacement estimate, a settlement offer and release, a denial letter, a subrogation demand and a claim payment record, each against the policy, the first notice, the inspection record and claim file, the approved scope, the claim valuation, the claim record, the payment record or the settlement or adjudication it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral across property, casualty and liability claims and reads different claim documents against each other and against the policy. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-claims-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-claims/.
